headline: German Bunds head for best month since February on tech selloff safety bid
summary: German government bonds are positioned for their strongest monthly gain since February. Demand for safe-haven debt surged as global investors fled equity market weakness in technology stocks.
why: German Bunds serve as the benchmark risk-free rate for the eurozone. Yields fall (and prices rise) when investors seek safety during broader risk-asset selloffs.

impacts.name: Germany 10-year yield
impacts.why: Increased capital flows into safe-haven German government bonds push yields lower and bond prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A global pullback in tech stocks prompted investors to reallocate funds into safe-haven German government debt.
